logic_group.name: libyaml document loader
logic_group.description: This logic group implements the YAML document loader, which is responsible for transforming a stream of YAML events into a complete document object model (DOM). It processes the sequential output of the parser and recursively constructs a tree of nodes, including scalars, sequences, and mappings. The loader specifically handles complex YAML features such as anchors and aliases, ensuring that cross-references within the document are correctly resolved and that the resulting graph structure is valid. It also manages the lifecycle and memory allocation of the nodes within the yaml_document_t structure.
